faint.$description: Barely visible, for hairline tints and ghost fills. Pairs with opacity.soft.

muted.$description: Half-transparent, for secondary or de-emphasised content. Pairs with opacity.strong.

soft.$description: Light transparency for disabled states and soft overlays. Pairs with opacity.faint.

strong.$description: Mostly opaque, for scrims and dimmed content that stays legible. Pairs with opacity.muted.
